Has an explosion radius of 8. }} {{QuoteContainer| {{QuoteBox|They strapped a bomb to a duck!|audio = BathroomApproachWave 13 1.ogg|[[Dispatcher]] dialogue on Wave 6 ([[Bathroom Approach]])}} }} ==Description== The '''Explosive Ducky''' was an enemy that appeared in [[Bathroom Approach]] as part of the [[Ducky Revenge Event]] and its rerun in the [[Spring Frenzy Battle Pass]]. It has high health and slightly fast speed. Upon death, the '''Explosive Ducky''' falls over for a few seconds, then it explodes, stunning towers for 1 seconds and dealing 50 damage to units caught in its explosion radius of 8. ==Logbook Description== "''Explosive Ducky exists because Missile Ducky convinced a duckling that the explosive strapped to them was a jetpack. Spoiler alert: It's definitely not a jetpack.''" ==Appearance== The '''Explosive Ducky''' is a duck with an orange beak and orange flippers, as as a yellow body. It has two explosives wrapped around the side of body. It has three animations that it can randomly have, where all three also have differently shaped eyes. The first animation has it have a happy expression, the second has it have a serious expression while the third one has its eyes partially closed, likely because it is scared. ==Event Strategy== As this enemy only appears through [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode, no strategy section is made for its current version. Instead, a strategy section for the one that appeared without [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode in [[Bathroom Approach]] is listed instead. *The '''Explosive Ducky''' can easily stun crowds of towers and damage multiple enemies with its ''Interstate Terrorism''. **Stun immune towers, like the [[Mortar]], [[Pursuit]], [[Ranger]] or [[Ace Pilot]] can be used to remove the threat of stuns entirely. **Towers with high range, like the [[Turret]], [[Golden Crook Boss]] or [[Rocketeer]], can be used to damage the '''Explosive Ducky''' from afar, making them far less likely to be stunned. ==Sounds== {{Sounds| {{{!}} class{{=}}"article-table align-center" style{{=}}"width:750px; margin:0 auto;" {{!}}- ! style{{=}}"width:30%;" {{!}}Sound ! style{{=}}"width:70%;" {{!}}Description {{!}}- {{!}}[[File:ExplosiveDuckyInterstateTerrorism.ogg]] {{!}}When the '''Explosive Ducky''' performs ''Interstate Terrorism'' ability upon death {{!}}} }} ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Converted Variants}} DefHacker1ExplosiveDucky.png|Green variant, current version (11 June 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Corpse Variants}} CorpseExplosiveDucky.png|Second [[Corpse (Enemy)|Corpse]] variant, current version (16 April 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Promotional Images}} DuckHunt2025PI3.png|'''Explosive Ducky''' on a promotional image. {{GalleryHeader|Promotional Videos}} Ducky Battlepass - Tower Defense Simulator|'''Explosive Ducky''' on a promotional video. {{GalleryHeader|Trailers}} Ducky Revenge Trailer - Tower Defense Simulator|'''Explosive Ducky''' in the game trailer. {{GalleryHeader|Miscellaneous}} ExplosiveDuckyIconIG.png|'''Explosive Ducky''' on its [[Index]] icon. }} ==Trivia== *The '''Explosive Ducky''' is unaffected by enemy appearance [[modifiers]], such as [[Talk Like a Pirate Day]]. ==Update History== *'''16 April 2025''' -
